Name: Pam's true form - TrashPam (WITH CONTENT PATCHER)
Author: Slashixo
Description:
I took the original sprites and portraits changes by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/45202127]lounakamura[/url]﻿'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2358]PamTrash[/url]﻿ mod and made it compatible with Content Patcher.

You need to have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400?tab=files]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] as well.

When you have those installed, simply extract the files in common/Stardew Valley/mods.

I did not create the sprites and the portraits, they come from the game itself.
